title: Chocolate Raspberry Whipped Cream
brief: A rich and indulgent whipped cream, perfect for topping cocktails or desserts.
description: Fresh raspberry and chocolate creamy cocktail foam. Inspired by a chocolate selection from Hotel Chocolat, this velvet topping was created to accompany a pistatio-cream washed bourbon, the foam's rose tint since beautifuly upon the bottle green liqueur. It's the perfect treat for the pastel girlies
instructions: Crush/blend the frozen raspberries and strain to extract the juice.
Boil the hot chocolate powder with 100ml of water to create a hot chocolate syrup, and let it cool.
Add the raspberry juice, the hot chocolate syrup and the whipping cream to a bowl and mix gently to incorperate the ingredients.
Once the mixture is well combined, mix aggresively by hand or with a mixer until the mixture starts to thicken and form soft peaks.
Apply the whipped cream to your cocktail or dessert and enjoy!
notes: If you own a cream whipper, the ingredients can be added to the canister after step 3and charged with a cream whipper cartridge (NO2).

title: Pistacio Bourbon
brief: A nutty, creamy bourbon with a punch of pistacio
description: Originally created to be featured in an experimental cocktail menu, the pistatio bouron ended up being a star in its own right, and may have been consumed before the intended cocktail was even tested... The pistacio cream fat-washed bourbon is a unique and flavorful spirit that combines the rich, nutty flavor of pistachios with the smooth, warming qualities of bourbon. The process of fat-washing involves infusing the bourbon with the flavors of the pistachio cream, resulting in a complex and delicious spirit that can be enjoyed on its own or used as a base for cocktails.
instructions: Spread the pistacio cream evenly on the bottom of a sealable container.
Gently pour the bourbon over the pistacio cream, and seal the container.
Place the container in the fridge and let it infuse for 24-48 hours.
Once the bourbon has been infused, gently pour out the liquid, through a strainer/cheesecloth, into a clean bottle.
Serve over ice and enjoy!
notes: For a stronger infusion, mix and blend the pistacio cream and bourbon together before placing in the freezer for 24-48 hours. Then remove the frozen layer and strain the liquid through a coffee filter/cheesecloth, into a clean bottle.

title: Ginger Syrup
brief: A spicy and sweet ginger syrup, the best way to add a kick to cocktails or mocktails.
description: This ginger syrup is a versatile and flavorful addition to any cocktail or mocktail. Made with fresh ginger, sugar, and water, it has a perfect balance of sweetness and spiciness that can enhance the flavor of any drink. Whether you're looking to add a little heat to your favorite cocktail or want to create a refreshing non-alcoholic beverage, this ginger syrup is sure to become a staple in your bar.
instructions: Peel and thinly slice the fresh ginger.
Combine the chopped ginger, sugar, and water in a saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally until the sugar has dissolved.
Reduce the heat, cover with a lid, and let it simmer for about 20 minutes, allowing the flavors to infuse.
Remove from heat and let it cool completely.
Strain the syrup through a fine mesh sieve or cheesecloth into a clean bottle.
Add to hot water with lemon for a soothing tea!
notes: For an extra kick, you can add a pinch of cayenne pepper or a few slices of jalapeño during the simmering process.

title: Pomogranate and Clover Cordial
brief: A sweet and tangy cordial with a floral note, perfect for adding depth to cocktails or mocktails.
description: This pomegranate and clover cordial is a delicious and versatile addition to any cocktail or mocktail. Made with fresh pomegranate juice, sugar, and clover honey, it has a perfect balance of sweetness and tanginess with a subtle floral note. Whether you're looking to add a unique twist to your favorite cocktail or want to create a refreshing non-alcoholic beverage, this cordial is sure to become a staple in your bar.
instructions: Combine the pomegranate juice, sugar, and whole clovers in a saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally until the sugar has dissolved.
Reduce the heat, cover with a lid, and let it simmer for about 15 minutes, allowing the flavors to infuse.
Remove from heat and let it cool completely.
Strain the cordial through a fine mesh sieve or cheesecloth into a clean bottle.
Mix with iced soda water for a refreshing summer drink!
notes: Experiment with different types of christmas spices, such as cinnamon sticks, star anise, or nutmeg, to create your own unique flavor profile.

title: Clarified Amarula and Vermouth Liqueur
brief: A clear and golden liqueur with a rich, creamy texture and a complex flavor profile.
description: This clarified amarula and vermouth liqueur is a luxurious and sophisticated addition to any bar. Made by clarifying the base ingredients, it has a crystal-clear appearance and a smooth, velvety texture with a rich, creamy flavor. Whether you're looking to add a touch of elegance to your favorite cocktail or just enjoy a sophisticated aperitivo, this clarified liqueur is go to.
instructions: Combine the amarula and sweet vermouth in an 'easy to pour container'.
Stir the mix and let is sit for 30 minutes. (You will notice the mixture will start to curdle)
Stir the mixture gently again and pour through a cheesecloth or coffee filter several times into a clean bottle, until the liquid is clear and free of any solids.
Serve over ice and enjoy!
notes: The clarification process requires careful attention to temperature and timing to achieve the best results.
